nodes.text_content:
Amelda is a cloud-free notes and journaling application.

* You own your data.
* Your data is saved on your device.
* Works Offline
* You decide when to share it and with whom.
* We will never collect your data or give it to a third party.

Tap the note just below this one to read more…
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
Amelda is semi-structured. This means that individual notes can be connected to organize and navigate between notes.

The note in the middle panel is the focused note. 

You can focus any note by tapping on it. 

Once focused, you can edit a note by tapping Edit. Tap Submit to save.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
Notes in the vertical dimension are sequentially connected to the focused note. 

Tapping New Note adds a new note after the currently focused note. 

You can scroll through sequential notes by clicking on a note in the upper or lower panels to focus the note.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
Notes in the horizontal dimension are conceptual connections to the focused note.

The left side shows suggested connections (notes that share topics). You can connect these explicitly by tapping the + in the suggested connection. 

The right side shows notes that you explicitly connected to the focused note.

On a phone, click the small arrows on the sides to reveal the left and right panels.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
To find and focus a note that isn’t on the screen, type some text in Find Note (in the center panel). Notes containing that text will appear. Select one to focus.

To connect the focused note to a note that isn’t on the screen, type some text in Search to Connect (in the right panel). Notes containing the text will appear. Select one to connect to the focused note.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
Your notes are saved in your browser. 

You can save your notes to a file if you want to share them or open elsewhere:

* Tap the hamburger menu in the top right panel.

* To export all notes connected to the focused note, tap Export Connected

* To export all notes, tap Export All

* Type in a username or some nickname to identify the owner of these notes.

 * Tap OK to save

Note: A group of connected notes is called a Graph.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content:
Amelda saves all your data locally automatically. 

To open an external graph, tap Open Graph and find the previously saved file and select it.

Only the external graph will be shown. To close it, tap Close Graph in the hamburger menu.

Any changes you made will be saved to the file.
nodes.creator: amelda

nodes.text_content: To get started on your own notes, click the New Note button twice!
